name: Latin Hypercube Sampler
description: Selects experimental conditions from a pool using Latin Hypercube Sampling with stratification. Partitions conditions into hypercubes, excludes those containing reference conditions, then randomly selects one sample per remaining hypercube for better space coverage.

sample.name: num_samples
sample.description: Number of experimental conditions to select from the pool.

sample.name: less_then
sample.description: For each column in the conditions, an order function can be defined to use for stratification.

sample.name: random_state
sample.description: Seed for random number generator to ensure reproducibility.

inputDataType.name: conditions
inputDataType.description: Pool of candidate experimental conditions to sample from.

inputDataType.name: reference_conditions
inputDataType.description: Pre-existing conditions used to exclude occupied hypercubes from sampling.

outputDataType.name: conditions
outputDataType.description: Selected experimental conditions using Latin Hypercube Sampling.
